title: Model Catalog Release: Readiness Matrix and Communication Runway
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: Coordinate cross-team steps to onboard a new model into the Redwood public catalog with clear ownership, artifact deadlines, and a single source of truth for release notes and launch comms. Scope: catalog entry, benchmark results, performance profile, docs (API & migration guidance), release notes, marketing announcement, sales enablement, and post-launch monitoring. Out of scope: model training, core runtime kernel changes (handled in ENG-4578). Goal: deliver a low-friction model addition that preserves platform SLOs, signals quality via benchmark artifacts, and gives customers clear migration and cost-impact guidance.

Docs (Maya Patel) — Draft API examples, migration notes, model-specific parameters, and known limitations — Due: 2026-03-22 — Deliverable: docs PR with examples and code samples
Design (Noah Kim) — Prepare catalog tile assets and short copy for catalog listing — Due: 2026-03-22 — Deliverable: image assets + microcopy
Security/Compliance (Jordan Li) — Complete model data-sensitivity review and KMS guidance for private deployments — Due: 2026-03-19 — Deliverable: security sign-off note
Console/Obs (Ruth Becker) — Create cost & latency dashboard, add model tag to routing policies, and set default alert thresholds — Due: 2026-03-24 — Deliverable: dashboard link and alert runbook
Marketing (Sophie Nguyen) — Draft customer-facing announcement, blog outline, and PR plan for social channels — Due: 2026-03-25 — Deliverable: announcement draft + publishing schedule
Sales/CS Enablement (Omar Hassan) — Prepare one-pager, sample pitch, and collateral for enterprise customers including Dedicated/Private guidance — Due: 2026-03-26 — Deliverable: enablement deck

Release Notes (PM) — Compile release notes draft using template, collect sign-offs, and lock final language — Due: 2026-03-27 — Deliverable: release-notes.md in repo

Post-launch (PM) — Monitor first 72 hours for latency regressions, error spikes, and customer support tickets; convene post-mortem if thresholds breached — Due: 2026-04-04 — Deliverable: launch health summary
release_notes_template:
Title: <Model Name> added to Redwood Catalog (catalog-2026.04)
Summary: One-line description of model capability and recommended use cases.
Performance: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, memory footprint, cost guidance vs nearest baseline.
Breaking changes: list changes to API or behavior (if any).
Migration notes: if users should change params or prompts, include examples.
Known limitations: failure modes or degraded cases.
Security: data handling guidance and any PII concerns.
Links: docs, benchmarks, SDK examples, support link.
comms_plan: Pre-announce (internal) — 72h before: Slack channel #product-launch, exec summary with key metrics and link to readiness matrix
Pre-announce (external beta) — 48h before: Email to opt-in customers and developer newsletter with early access instructions
Public announcement — Day 0: Blog post + social + product changelog; coordinate publishing times with marketing
Support operations — Day 0: Enable canned responses in Zendesk, provide CS with one-pager, and host an office hours session for the first week
Post-launch updates — Day 3 and Day 7: Share health summary and any mitigations; escalate if rollback required
go_live_criteria: Performance: p95 latency and error rate within 10% of baseline service SLOs under representative load
Benchmarks: quality (ROUGE/BLEU or embedding similarity) within acceptance thresholds set by Research
Docs: API examples and migration notes merged and published to docs site
Security: security sign-off obtained and KMS guidance documented for private deployments
Ops: dashboard and alerting in place and oncall notified
rollback_criteria: Sustained p95 latency > 2x baseline for 15+ minutes despite autoscaling steps
Error rate > 5% of requests for 10+ minutes impacting core endpoints
Regression in quality leading to customer-visible failures on >3 incoming support tickets tied to the new model
Unmitigated security or data leakage concerns discovered post-launch
monitoring_and_metrics: Latency p50/p95/p99 per region and per API route
Request success rate and HTTP 5xx trends
Tokens generated per second and cost per 1k tokens estimate
Cache hit rates (prefix/KV) for common prompts
Customer support ticket count and sentiment for queries mentioning the model
notes: 2026-03-11: Kickoff meeting held with Eng, Research, Docs, and Security. Agreed on core benchmarks and baseline comparisons.
2026-03-12: Research requested additional dataset slice for safety checks — assigned to Diego.
2026-03-13: Design mock for catalog tile approved with minor copy edits; assets in progress.
Risks: potential latency regression at large seq lengths; mitigation: limit initial max_tokens recommendation and add explicit guidance in docs.
Next steps: lock performance artifacts by 2026-03-20 and finalize release notes by 2026-03-27.
